title: Bontlentle jo bo Nwetseng
intro: Akanya fela ka seno: moya o o apesitsweng diaparo tse dintle mme o dikologilwe ke matlotlo a a fetang a o ka a akanyang. Motho yono o ne a dumela gore khumo ya gagwe e ne e bonwa ka botlhale jwa gagwe, a sa amogele le ka motlha motswedi wa tlamelo ya boammaaruri. A tsamaya mo gare ga balatedi ba moporofeti yo o nonofileng, motho yono o ne a gana pitso nngwe le nngwe ya boikokobetso. Gompieno, re ribolola boitshupo jwa motho yo khumo ya gagwe e e kgatlhang e neng ya nna lefelo la bone la bofelo la boikhutso.
clues: Ke ne ke tshela ka nako ya moporofeti yo o neng a bitsa morafe o o tlhogoethata kwa boammaaruring.
Ke ne ke le karolo ya setšhaba se se tlhophilweng, le fa go ntse jalo pelo ya me e ne ya fapoga molaetsa.
Gauta le selefera di ne tsa nkgatlha go feta taelo epe ya bomodimo.
Dipolokelo tsa me tsa letlotlo di ne tsa gola thata jaana mo e leng gore setlhopha se se nonofileng sa banna se ne se sa kgone go tsholetsa dinotlolo ka bothata.
Ke ne ka ipoka ka re khumo ya me ke e neilwe ka ntlha ya kitso ya me.
Kwa bofelong, nna le bonno jwa me jotlhe re ne ra mediwa ke lefatshe e le tlhagiso.

options: Matlotlo a dinotlolo tsa one di neng di imetsa banna ba le bantsi ba ba nonofileng
Namane ya gauta e e neng e ntsha modumo
Terone e e galalelang e e tswang kwa lefatsheng le le kgakala

location.answer: Matlotlo a dinotlolo tsa one di neng di imetsa banna ba le bantsi ba ba nonofileng

outcome.answer: E meditswe ke lefatshe mmogo le bonno

arabic: فَخَرَجَ عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ فِى زِينَتِهِۦ ۖ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يُرِيدُونَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا يَـٰلَيْتَ لَنَا مِثْلَ مَآ أُوتِىَ قَـٰرُونُ إِنَّهُۥ لَذُو حَظٍّ عَظِيمٍۢ
verse: So he came out before his people in his adornment. Those who desired the worldly life said, "Oh, would that we had like what was given to Qārūn. Indeed, he is one of great fortune." (28:79)
